public_description: human-grounded inputs with self-derived canonical labels

v1.why: every v1 row carries the coin-flip ASK label, the folded reasons, and a 14-action schema in which 9 action types are unreachable; importing v1 rows as semantic roots would import exactly the catalogued defects

v2.rule: V3 inherits V2's semantics and machinery, not V2's sealed row identity

v2_seal.role_after_v3: independent historical and evaluation artifact; not extended by v3

seal_has_two_source_manifests.note: v2's seal records TWO source manifests by design, because the G10 repair regenerated only the paired panels. Inheriting a hash means reading the manifest that corresponds to the stage being inherited.
seal_has_two_source_manifests.source_manifest: hashes as of the ROW stage, i.e. before the G10 paired-panel repair
seal_has_two_source_manifests.pairs_stage_source_manifest: hashes as of the PAIRED-PANEL stage, i.e. the current on-disk state after the repair; all 22 entries verified matching on 2026-09-30
seal_has_two_source_manifests.why: pinning against the row-stage manifest would make v3's inheritance contract unrestorable, because build.py and interventions.py legitimately differ between the two stages

inherited_by_pinned_reference.item: V2 derivation rules that survive V2-0

v2.v3_generates_own_synthetic_core: W_synthetic^(3) ~ G_V2-compatible(theta_3) through the pinned v2 simulator
NOT_inherited: v2 row identity, world ids, or split identity

synthetic_core.why: lets v3 alter curriculum, capability balance, topology, composition depth and contrast structure without contaminating v2's frozen bank identity

external_data.v2_invariant: external_rows_imported == 0  (a defining invariant of v2, not an implementation detail)
external_data.v3_invariant: no outside material entered anonymously or without an admissible transformation path
external_data.why_new_constitution: v3 intentionally violates v2's founding assumption, so inheriting v2 G14 would make the seal dishonest

label_provenance.annotation_equation: y_human travels ALONGSIDE as a check, never as canonical truth
label_provenance.constitutional_prohibition: direct inheritance of external annotations as labels is prohibited
label_provenance.why: a human annotation is incomplete and is not a function of any record that can be written down; inheriting it makes provenance unverifiable, which is the v1 disease in new clothes
label_provenance.disagreements_are: a dataset diagnostic, never silently reconciled

PARTIAL_RECONSTRUCTION.may_contribute: renderer and natural-language material, only with explicitly bounded preserved semantics
PARTIAL_RECONSTRUCTION.must_not: pretend to witness facts it cannot reconstruct

label_provenance.source_selection_criterion: how much of a source's semantic structure survives exact reconstruction into the v2 world algebra; the agreement rate is part of source selection
label_provenance.expected_surprise: some famous datasets may prove to be poor seeds, and some obscure dataset with highly reconstructable structure may prove to be gold; the design must be able to reveal that

root_and_lineage.lineage_invariant: every descendant -> exactly one canonical root -> declared transformation -> declared preserved semantics -> declared changed semantics -> verifier receipt
root_and_lineage.goal: train on differences, not just classes

capability_axes.note: structural capability annotation on every root and every generated child, so curricula are constructed rather than assembled by shuffling
capability_axes.rejected_alternative: shuffle three million rows and pray

firewall_gates_v3.name: DESCENDANT LINEAGE
asserts: exactly one canonical root per descendant

firewall_gates_v3.name: NO V1 ROWS AS ROOTS
asserts: no root has a v1 world_id or a v1 world_hash

sequence: freeze v3 target and curriculum constitution

v2_0.why_first: cheap, deterministic, already frozen; its purpose is to answer whether obvious cue structure exists before v2 semantics are treated as substrate for model work

permitted_responses: decorrelate the target from the identified shortcut
move the target to diagnostic-only status
cue_accessible_disposition.prohibited: manufacturing millions of descendants around a target whose decision boundary is already encoded in a cheap accidental cue

composition.v3_equals: V2 exact semantic core + new capability curriculum + witnessed external reconstruction
composition.share_caveat: true of VOLUME, not of LABEL PROVENANCE; supervision is what matters, and if labels are self-derived the honest description is human-grounded inputs with self-derived labels

root_reconstruction_blocked_by: V2-0 disposition, plus the reconstruction-yield probe (O1)

requires: a versioned amendment to BANK-V3-FREEZE.md written before the corresponding code or corpus change
a new bank-v3-objects.json with an incremented version and a regenerated sha256 sidecar
an amendment log entry recording what changed, why, and which v1/v2 finding motivated it

open_items.severity: high - it is the unblocking measurement and V2-0 does not answer it
open_items.question: what fraction of candidate-source roots reach EXACT_RECONSTRUCTION, per source and per target family
open_items.why_v2_0_does_not_answer_it: V2-0 measures cue accessibility of v2's own synthetic semantics; it says nothing about whether an external human dataset can be reconstructed into that algebra at all
open_items.why_it_matters: the source roster, the root budget, and the whole premise of v3 depend on this number; a low yield would mean v3 is mostly synthetic with a thin human veneer, which is a legitimate outcome but must be discovered before building a corpus on the opposite assumption

open_items.resolution: targets.py pinned to 72c1cfa0ed44e2793c5272b0b500e5728e6126471cb87f536315fdd9da49211b from the v2 pairs-stage manifest, verified against disk

open_items.note: which v2 derivation rules survive V2-0 is not yet known; it is an input to the inheritance contract, not an output of it. The one unpinned inheritance entry is exactly this one.

done_when: V2-0 has run and its cue-accessibility findings are dispositioned per target
reconstruction-yield probe O1 has reported per-source EXACT_RECONSTRUCTION rates
every external source has a complete license record with all four permission flags resolved
G14-V3, G-EXT-TRUTH, G-LINEAGE and G-V1-EXCLUSION PASS at 100%
every descendant resolves to exactly one canonical root with a verifier receipt
the agreement statistic Pr(y_human == y_derived) is reported per source and per target family
source selection is justified by reconstruction yield, not by dataset reputation
